meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: Claude 会通过统一 Python 接口访问 40 多个生物数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等），用于检索蛋白质、查通路、搜化合物、转换 ID，并在一个工作流中整合数据。
howto.when: 当用户要求同时查询多个生物数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等）、做跨库 ID 映射，或在一个流程中整合多个数据源时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 UniProt 查 P43403 的序列，并映射到 KEGG。
say.note: 会先检索序列，再调用映射接口转换 ID。

say.text: 分析 KEGG 通路 hsa04660 的蛋白互作，并转成 SIF 格式。
say.note: 会提取通路关系并输出 SIF 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude will use a unified Python interface to query 40+ bioinformatics databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) for retrieving proteins, pathways, compounds, converting IDs, and integrating data in one workflow.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to query multiple biological databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) in one workflow, perform cross-database ID mapping, or integrate several data sources.

say_en.text: Look up the sequence for P43403 in UniProt and map it to KEGG.
say_en.note: Retrieves the sequence then converts the identifier.

say_en.text: Analyze KEGG pathway hsa04660 interactions and export as SIF.
say_en.note: Extracts pathway relations and exports SIF.

say_en.text: Convert the KEGG ID for compound Geldanamycin to a ChEMBL ID.
